development.source: current cleaned web datasets and current libraries

precoordination_entry.reference: old date_conditioned estimate on identical positive hits
precoordination_entry.rule: Only models passing this gate may enter new risk coordination; failures retain raw diagnostics and simple fixed-total control only

bounds.upper: min(past dish q99 * 2, old final quantity * 2); second comparison may use distribution q90 within the same cap
bounds.infeasible: whole-meal baseline fallback with explicit reason; do not widen bounds or move across units
bounds.preparation: max(predicted recorded sales, operating minimum); separately scored

families: conditional-distribution risk coordination if raw forecast improves
models.low_state_threshold: past meal/unit positive-record q10, never target actual quantile
models.hit_training_control: same all-offered warmup; after warmup only previous baseline-selected supplied records
models.zero_handling: retained in fitting and separate absolute-error evaluation; no zero MAPE denominator
models.unavailable_information: No supply quantity, stockout, closure or latent-demand claims; holiday end distance omitted unless explicitly known in calendar inputs

interval_gate.comparison: unconditional empirical residual interval from same independent point model
interval_gate.require: report interval score, coverage, width and low-state Brier/AUC; no width tuning after results

ablation: all supplied vs old hits; with/without old forecast; point vs conditional leaf vs hurdle; mean/log/relative/mixed decisions; old projection vs distribution risk for eligible raw model; remove each retained component

stop.rule: stop after >=3 distinct structural directions and sensible combinations/ablations fail immutable gates; no repetition of equivalent tuning

deployment: independent modules; preserve current web default and original versions
retest: optional only after freeze; no reuse of 2026 for selection or stopping
